title: There Will Come Soft Rains (1950) [pdf]
summary: Ray Bradbury's classic 1950 short story 'There Will Come Soft Rains' imagines a fully automated house in a post-apocalyptic world continuing its daily routines after a nuclear bomb has killed its human inhabitants, exploring themes of technology's indifference to humanity.
problem_solved: This is not a technical solution but rather a literary work exploring humanity's relationship with technology and the atomic age anxieties of the mid-20th century.
why_valuable: The story serves as a prescient meditation on automation, nuclear war, and the eerie persistence of technology after humanity's potential demise.
